events.title: Synergy 360° Session
events.description: SYNERGY 360° SESSION IS FINALLY HERE ☆ When she plays Fabric London, Watergate Berlin and SASH Sydney... you listen. Monika Ross is back on the Gold Coast for a rare, intimate 360° set. Synergy's first ever boiler room-inspired session. The sound surrounds you, the energy is in a circle. This is raw, underground house, minimal, breaks & garage the way it's meant to be heard. With ROSSCO + Felipe Gonzalez opening the journey from 6pm in the Warehouse. Where the dancefloor surrounds the booth, where we all become one, connected by the rhythm of sound. ♡︎ We welcome Monika Ross, Ross Weightman AKA ROSSCO, Federico Gonzales, Navarro(BR) B2B Rolo to bless your ear drums. All coming together to provide groovy blends of banging electronic rhythms to take you on a journey. MONIKA ROSS Our headliner, is a widely respected DJ and producer with raw, authentic sounds that move effortlessly through minimal, house, breaks and garage. Fresh from her European tour, we welcome her home. Her dynamic sets and signature sound have led to appearances at some of the most iconic venues worldwide including SASH (Sydney), Fabric (London), Club der Visionaere (Berlin), Watergate (Berlin), PAL (Hamburg), and Oxford Underground (Sydney), among others. ROSS WEIGHTMAN (ROSSCO) Joining her is Ross Weightman AKA ROSSCO, spins house music rooted in deep, funky, progressive grooves, to make you move. He has a big energy you will feel it when he does what he loves! Beyond the booth, you may also recognise him from Love Island Australia! FELIPE GONZALES Opening the journey is FELIPE GONZALEZ, blending the ultimate progressive, organic house with melodic sounds sets shaped by his Argentinian roots. Felipe has the ability of reading the room and shapes his selections around the energy of the crowd. Get here early to watch the magic unfold. NAVARRO(BR) B2B ROLO Introducing Navarro(BR) & Rolo, our Brazilian & Colombian DJ's, producers of the movement Shut Up and Dance, also supported by Solomon, the Martinez Brothers, Franky Rizardo, we are delighted to welcome you to the Synergy family. Catch the boys building the atmosphere from the ground up, shaping the room and we're excited to connect our communities together. Let's go! This is going to be one for the books. We would love YOU to experience it with us. Limited capacity, don't sleep on it! ONE LOVE ♡︎ Synergy familiiiliaaaa ꩜ Who are Synergy? heeEeelllloooo there :) we’re over the moon you found us. Synergy is an independent music events organiser originating in Bristol, England, that crossed the pond to sunny Straya. A collective built around the power of music to bring people together, to bless your ear drums with incredible music. Our events create high energy spaces, a dance floor where you feel free, a place to let loose, get weird and be you :) A place you feel comfy. Like home. Surrounded by good vibez. With a focus on raw, finely selected electronic music. A little gritty-funky-underground flavour. FOLLOW OUR JOURNEY - for more Synergy adventures ♡︎ @synergyevents._ Doors at 6pm (18+) with the venue's El Ranchero back deck and bar open from 6pm for preshow dinner and drinks. events.title: ADALITA (GOLD COAST)
events.description: Released in 2011, Adalita’s self-titled debut marked the beginning of her remarkable solo journey. Raw, intimate, and emotionally fearless, it struck a deep chord with listeners and remains one of the most beloved and influential Australian releases of its time. To mark its fifteenth anniversary, Adalita reunites with original collaborator JP Shilo to perform the album in full, revisiting the songs that first began this extraordinary chapter. Coinciding with the tour, Adalita will also be reissued on vinyl through Mushroom Music, bringing a long out-of-print favourite back to fans fifteen years on. Don’t miss these special shows. Supported by JP Shilo and more. WILL SELL OUT / GET IN EARLY! Doors at 7pm. El Ranchero back deck/bar and Spanish Girl Food Co will be open from 6pm for preshow dinner and drinks. events.title: MO'S 7TH BIRTHDAY (Main Day) feat. Peach Fur
events.description: For over seven unforgettable years, our walls have reverberated with the energies of thousands of cosmic souls, creating what is certainly a much-loved community based on music, inclusion and self-expression. To celebrate our 7th official birthday, we invite you to our main day night mass, featuring 12 of the best touring and local acts over two seamless stages with pagan-themed pop ups, flash tattoos, all ages access options, games and prizes. The birthday main day will be headlined by Gold Coast lords PEACH FUR, in what will be their first local show since announcing their last gig ever back in 2024, amidst an all-star cast of local and touring acts with the full lineup featuring: * PEACH FUR * CHEAP FAKES * WOODHILL * ROXFERRY * KARL S WILLIAMS * BOOF HEADS * COSMIC VICE * The return of STINGIN ROGERS * KRYSTAL RIVVERS * RINSER * BOYS AT THE BACK * LIPLINE Dress in your darkest ceremonial attire, gather beneath the moon and join us as we honour seven years of noise, chaos, and communion.
